defensives.name: Ardent Defender
defensives.usage_rule: Save this as your biggest damage reduction cooldown and use it during the most dangerous period of a pull or encounter.

defensives.name: Divine Shield
defensives.usage_rule: Use this as your emergency immunity to survive a hit or shed a debuff that would otherwise kill you.

defensives.name: Guardian of Ancient Kings
defensives.usage_rule: Cycle this defensive actively during a high damage intake period instead of saving it only for the single worst moment.

defensives.name: Blessing of Protection
defensives.usage_rule: Cycle this defensive actively on yourself or an ally during a high damage intake period.

defensives.name: Blessing of Sacrifice
defensives.usage_rule: Cycle this defensive actively during a high damage intake period to share incoming damage with yourself.

defensives.name: Lay on Hands
defensives.usage_rule: Use this as a large emergency heal during a high damage intake period when you need to survive right now.
